SELECT FROM pf_private_file WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND hash=#{hash} AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT FROM pf_private_file WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE'

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pf_private_reference WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND source_ref=#{source}

mapper.update: UPDATE pf_private_file SET status='DELETE_PENDING' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{file} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE pf_private_file SET status='DELETED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{file} AND status='DELETE_PENDING'

mapper.delete: DELETE r FROM pf_private_reference r JOIN pf_private_file f ON f.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND f.id=r.file_id WHERE f.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND f.id=#{file} AND f.status='DELETED'
